description: This file defines system-level structures, enums, and inline functions for the Arctic Core AUTOSAR platform, including system configuration, task and interrupt management, and resource handling.

methods.name: Os_SchedulerResourceIsFree
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler resource is free (not owned by any task).

methods.name: Os_SysTaskSetCurr
methods.description: Sets the current task pointer in the system structure.

methods.name: Os_SysTaskGetCurr
methods.description: Retrieves the current task pointer from the system structure.

methods.name: Os_SysIntAnyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if any interrupt disable or suspend counters are non-zero.

methods.name: Os_SysIntClearAll
methods.description: Clears all interrupt disable and suspend counters.
